anchor: Resolve day offsets relative to source receipt in the owner's named timezone.

source: 明天上午的课程从9点改到11点，教室不变。

cases.expected: Only the bound occurrence becomes 11:00-12:00, conditional provider readback succeeds; a previously configured relative reminder moves with it.
